mapper.sql: id, kb_id::text AS kb_id, filename, filetype, size, metadata::text AS metadata, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document (kb_id, filename, filetype, size, metadata) VALUES (CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid), #{filename}, #{filetype}, #{size}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM document WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
SELECT FROM document WHERE kb_id = CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid) ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM document WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.update:
UPDATE document
filename = #{filename}, filetype = #{filetype}, size = #{size}, metadata = CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
